time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t * fps)
description: Night-time loading dock. A long blue roller/belt conveyor runs left-to-right across the image (top surface at y~405-412) into the open rear of a truck on the right. Parcels lie on the belt and are carried to the RIGHT at a steady rate during the whole clip. Three workers stand behind the belt (only upper bodies visible). Hand-held/drifting camera: slow pan of ~-17 px (x) and ~-7 px (y) over the clip, plus ~0.3% scale change and ~0.56 deg roll.

camera.motion: slow smooth drift. Image content moves left ~0.12 px/frame and up ~0.05 px/frame on average; total by frame 137: centre shift (-16.8, -6.8) px, scale 0.9967, rotation +0.56 deg. No shake/jumps.
camera.file: tracks/camera.csv (per frame affine A,t mapping frame-0 coords to current-frame coords: p_cur = [[a11,a12],[a21,a22]] p0 + [tx,ty]; centre_dx/dy = shift of the image centre)
camera.compensation: every parcel/person track also gives cx_bg, cy_bg = reference point mapped back to frame-0 background coordinates (use these for motion; image coords include the camera drift)
camera.perspective: belt edge is nearly horizontal across the image and all parcels sit on the same belt at about the same depth -> planar (2D) treatment is reasonable along the belt. The belt continues into the truck on the right (x>~900); the yellow bag there moves ~7% more px/frame than the others, suggesting that end of the belt is slightly closer to the camera or a separate faster segment.

track_columns.parcels: frame,t,cx_img,cy_img (visible-centre reference = centre of full rigid bbox, image coords),bbox_x0..y1 (full bbox, may extend outside image/behind pillar),visible_x0,visible_x1,visible_cx (clipped to image edge / pillar),cx_bg,cy_bg (reference point in frame-0 background coords, camera drift removed),left_edge_bg,right_edge_bg,length_px (along belt = motion direction),height_px,ncc,visible_frac,occluded
